subject.title: Chat context popover: show Anthropic plan usage (5h/weekly/credits) instead of meaningless cost on subscription billing

question: Should maintainers use the linked plan-usage PR as the canonical fix for this issue after repair, or require a narrower split before landing?
rationale: The fix spans Control UI, gateway auth-status, provider usage contracts, Anthropic/Claude CLI behavior, and billing display semantics, and the issue has a protected maintainer label.

options.title: Repair linked PR before merge
options.body: Use the existing PR as the canonical path, but require the cost-gating/proof/metadata blockers to be resolved before this issue closes.

options.title: Ask for a narrower split
options.body: Separate the claude-cli usage routing fix from the popover redesign so the low-risk provider mapping can land independently.

options.title: Wait for attribution contract
options.body: Hold plan/cost switching until session and usage payloads can identify the serving credential or billing mode.

recommendation.title: Repair linked PR before merge
recommendation.body: Use the existing PR as the canonical path, but require the cost-gating/proof/metadata blockers to be resolved before this issue closes.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest current code and related-PR history for the provider usage and chat popover surfaces.
